revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the service manager framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. The project office now requires a follow-up safety review whenever Activity E is accelerated. The E overtime option still shortens E by 3 days and keeps its listed overtime premium, but choosing it also triggers a 1000 Euro follow-up review. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
